content_text:
Hi Roger and everyone on the forum,
I am working on a shoot film over the weekend on Kodak 500T.
My question is about how to exposure 500t when shooting daylight without an 85 correction filter.
I will instead alter the white balance during the DI.
Would I have to compensate or can i just shoot at tungsten box speed?
